title: A link's text may hold balanced brackets
head: 19337d8a8b4cc04b3cdd1ba1b1e0d9736dfe853c

clause.text: a code span binds tighter than emphasis, struck-out text and a link's text, as on GitHub: ``**Pass `**kwargs` through**`` is "Pass **kwargs through" in bold, its `**kwargs` as code

scenes.caption: A code span still binds tighter than the link's text: "[the `[beta` guide](…)": its unbalanced [ in code, still a link

clause.text: a link's text may hold balanced brackets, as on GitHub: "Read [the [beta] guide](https://kotlinlang.org/docs)." is "Read the [beta] guide.", "the [beta] guide" a link

scenes.caption: "Read [the [beta] guide](…)." is "Read the [beta] guide.", "the [beta] guide" a link

clause.text: an unbalanced `[` is text, and a link holds no other link: in `[a [b](u) c](v)` only `b` is one

scenes.caption: An unbalanced [ is text; in [a [b](…) c](…) only b is a link
